decision: Removed Linux --no-sandbox and sandboxed the char page and studio windows with web security on
why: The player is served on aquastar://ruffle/ and Artix responses get a narrow CORS header, so file and https pages can load it without turning web security off. AppImage adds --no-sandbox only when unshare fails. The deb postinstall sets chrome-sandbox setuid only in that case. The process appends no-sandbox when both user namespaces and a setuid helper are missing
result: 206 tests passed. Electron smoke loaded ruffle.js and wasm from a file page, read the local studio SWF over https, renderer Seccomp 2, argv had no --no-sandbox

decision: Turned asar on and left asarUnpack empty
why: The renderer fetches the wasm, and file:// inside an asar cannot serve that fetch, so the game wrapper uses aquastar://ruffle/ which the main process reads from the archive. Plugins are required from the archive. realpath throws on archive members, so the helper check accepts an existing archive path. No native addon needs a real file
evidence: package.json asar true, dist/linux-unpacked/resources/app.asar 29M, unpacked dir 302M
result: 209 tests passed. Packed app activated adventure-quest-worlds and example-companion from app.asar. Example boxmover.swf drew. Studio helper started from an app.asar script path. No app.asar.unpacked directory

Startup to plugin-activated was 413, 322, 317 ms before and 318, 320, 322 ms after. Idle RSS main+renderer+gpu was 584260 KiB before and 587760 KiB after, one sample each, inside run noise. decision: Reload removes the Ruffle player on pagehide so its wasm instance is destroyed and the page sockets close. Clear cache clears the HTTP cache and the other network caches, and leaves localStorage, cookies, and aquastar.json
why: The shared socket relay stays up for other windows. A page reload closes that page's websockets, and the relay destroys the matching TCP sockets. The Smooth Motion flag and Ruffle save slots live in localStorage, so they are not in the clear list
result: 220 tests passed. Electron smoke: pagehide ran, one "Ruffle instance destroyed" log, a new instance loaded the SWF, localStorage and a settings file survived clearStorageData. A cached SWF stayed at 1 HTTP hit across reload and became 2 after clearCache. Relay test: live upstream sockets returned to 0 after the page socket closed
